description:
One of the two people in a session, as the other one sees them.

**Every name here is nullable, and that is the data rather than caution.**
`users.first_name` and `last_name` are both nullable columns, and the M2
transform maps them straight from optional Bubble fields — `record.get("First
Name")` — so a migrated user who never filled one in has `NULL`. A party with
no name at all is a real state, and the nulls go out as nulls: substituting
"Unknown" here would be a display decision made in the wrong layer, in one
language, that no client could change.

`avatar_url` is null for two independent reasons — the column is nullable,
and the whole `user_profiles` row may not exist. Both arrive as the same
null, which is why the join is outer.

**No email, no slug, no `last_active_at`.** The parties are meeting; that
does not make the rest of each other's account their business.

attendance_status.description:
**`pending` means *we do not know yet*, not absent.** It is the state of every party until the join window shuts, and counting it as absence would report everybody with a session next week as unreliable.

A party with no attendance record at all reports `pending` too — two of the migrated bookings have no participant row, and a missing row is not an arrival.

cover_art.description: What is drawn over the cover colour. `none` when they chose none.

cover_color.description: The colour they chose for their cover, one of `CoverColor`'s keys. `null` means automatic: hash the person's id over `CoverColor`'s values, in their published order. A mentee has no cover picker, so theirs is normally automatic.

degree.description: The degree that best describes this party, as the discovery card and a review's byline describe a person: their highest, then most recent ("BSc"). With `institution`, the pending card's "BSc Student at FUTA"; the wording is the client's. `null` with no education entry, or when they deleted their account.
degree.title: Degree

in_room.description:
Whether this party is in the video room **now**, for an EduFurther video (Daily) session (#394): `true` from the moment Daily reports them joining until it reports them leaving, and `true` again on a rejoin. A party open in two tabs stays `true` until both have left.

`false` once the session has ended, whatever Daily last said, because the room closes then and a lost leave must not keep somebody in it.

**`null` means *not reported*, not *absent***: Google Meet and custom venues send no presence, and neither does a session with no video room. Show nothing live for `null`.

Live within seconds of Daily's own webhook, so a page polling the session sees a change on its next read.
in_room.title: In Room

in_room_at.description:
When the video provider first saw this party in the room, for an EduFurther video (Daily) session; `null` until it has, and always `null` for Google Meet and custom venues, which report no presence. **The earliest sighting**, so a dropped call and a rejoin do not move it.

**It means *has been in the room*, not *is in the room now*.** Leaving does not clear it, so do not use it for a live *Here now*: that is `in_room`. Use it for *Joined* / *Didn't join*, and `joined_at` to decide who may re-enter. For a video session, attendance follows this: a party seen before arrivals stop is `attended`, and pressing Join without entering the room is not.
in_room_at.title: In Room At

institution.description: Where that degree is from: the registry's name, else what the person typed. `null` as for `degree`.
institution.title: Institution

joined_at.description:
When this party marked themselves present, or `null` if they have not. **The first arrival, not the latest** — pressing Join again after a dropped call does not move it.

`null` while a session is upcoming is the ordinary case, not a signal.

**This is the Join press, and it is what lets a party back in** after arrivals stop. For an EduFurther video session it is not attendance: that is `in_room_at` (#382).
joined_at.title: Joined At

timezone.description: This party's IANA time zone, for showing the other side what the hour is for them. `null` when they deleted their account.
timezone.title: Timezone
